nom: Pacifica Glow Baby Vitamin C Booster Serum

avis.texte: I applied this yesterday and my skin still feels so dewy. It was refreshing when I applied it, and the scent is wonderful and bright! I got this as a freebie for hitting a minimum order amount, well played team Pacifica. This is a wonderful product, I will certainly be trying more of the Glow Baby line!

I received a mini of this serum with my purchase (and I love everything Pacifica!!) I l'm not usually into serums, but my dry sensitive skin loved this! I used it alone one night and mixed it with lotion the next night. It's brightening and glowy like the name suggests, absorbs quickly but doesn't leave your skin feeling too tight but very smooth.
This product is wonderful!!! It makes my skin glow. I actually recommend it to my best friend and she got it and loves it

Affordable, works, love the smell. I use this with their vitamin C moisturizer and the one that has spf in (it is way to dark for me) but mixing it gives me the perfect coverage and glow. Been using for years.

avis.titre: Unhappy with this glow baby  purchase 😕
avis.texte: I've been purchasing this product for at least 6 mos but this time it was clunky.

avis.titre: I've used this product for years
avis.texte: I use this everyday, and I've definitely noticed a difference. My skin is much less dull. I combine it with the glow baby eye cream.

This was like an extra wake-up call for my skin. It seemed smoother and more awake after using. It felt great going on, while on, and afterwards. Feel this is a great product to use once or twice a week in addition to your usual skin care.

I have been using the original vitamin C serum for years. My dermatologist said I look great and continue to do whatever I'm doing. Unfortunately they have changed this. The picture is the same but the product is different. I'll have to look for a new vitamin c serum.

I love this. I use it in the mornings. It smells wonderful. On a fresh face, i apply this. and then my regular SPF moisturizer. It stays feeling light weight through the day and doesnt become oily. Also a fan of the pricepoint

I first bought this product a few years ago, and have loved it ever since! It feels so nice and cooling on the face, and it does a great job of keeping my skin hydrated and relatively free of blemishes! I'm not super prone to break outs, but I notice a difference in the look and feel of my skin when I use the serum everyday versus when I run out. The serum also smells great!!
Very sticky and pills up on skin, so i returned it, pointless if its going to pill up

Started to turn my skin orange, so I rinsed it off and was left with irritated redness all over, which rarely happens as my skin isn't that sensitive. It does have a pleasant scent, but it's super sticky, and looks like lemonade with pulp.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again!
avis.texte: I have repurchased so many times!! Makes me feel amazing and does exactly what it's supposed to .
I have received lots of compliments how my face looks brighter even in the winter months! I highly recommend this product for all skin types.

I've been using this for a few weeks now and my skin's texture and color are noticeably evened. I struggle with rashes from stress and weather and parts of my face become reddened and dry. This product has helped me immensely, and it smells like fresh orange juice. I also have issues with oil buildup on my face, and this product does not contribute to that! I am very happy with it
I love this serum! It's much less sticky than similar priced vitamin C serums. It also helps keep my pores clean. The cleanser is also a holy grail for me! It also does not irritate my skin barrier.

avis.titre: I've been using this for years!
avis.texte: I like the pacifica glow face wash. Along with the booster serum and use them everyday and take it for all my travels. Pairs perfectly with the glow moisturizing lotion. Gives a dewy glow. Highly recommend this product.
smells good, feels fine, but I couldn't use it bc my eyes constantly felt irritated when wearing it. I

avis.titre: Glow Baby Booster Serum Radiance in a Bottle
avis.texte: I've been using the Glow Baby Booster Serum for a few weeks now, and I'm truly impressed! The serum has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling hydrated and luminous. After consistent use, I've noticed a more even complexion and a natural glow. Plus, it's gentle on my skin and free of harsh chemicals.
Definitely improves the appearance of my skin. It gives me a dewy, healthy glow, and brightens my skin after cleansing. It appears to even my skin tone

Love the amazing glow that leaves my skin looking bright and hydrated. Super convenient little dispenser for just a few drops to truly transform into glowing skin that lasts all day long l. Absolutely love it

avis.titre: Brighten your skin instantly with Glow boosting serum
avis.texte: I really like this serum because it makes my skin look brighter and healthy without feeling thick or heavy. It's light and soaks in fast, so it works well with my other skincare stuff.
I love this product so much, I love how it makes my skin feel Love All 🥰🥰🥰🥰💖💖💖💖💖💖💖

avis.titre: Go ahead and add to cart
avis.texte: Love this serum. It has helped my skin's tone so much. I have been using it consistently for a few weeks and never knew how drastic of a change I'd see so soon. I'm not mad at it though!
I have dry skin and this has really saved the day. My complexion looks more awake, hydrated, and healthy. It smells really good too, like orange juice!
Unfortunately my skin broke out, large pimples that took a long time to heal. :(

avis.titre: This will be staying in my routine
avis.texte: LOVE THIS PRODUCT! Leaves your skin glowly, hydrated and smooth. I will never not wear this. Plus its great under makeup.
I like it and it makes me skin soft but it makes my hands feel sticky afterwards. I hate that feeling so I will not be buying this again.
I like it and it makes me skin soft but it makes my hands feel sticky afterwards. I hate that feeling so I will not be buying this again.

I have sensitive combination skin. I noticed there is a scent to this product, but it never bothered my skin. I would apply this serum prior to using sunscreen on my non-makeup days. I don't remember any dramatic changes, but I thought it was a fun step to my skin care routine.

avis.titre: Why does your skin look great?  (I'm almost 80.)
avis.texte: It goes on my skin first thing every morning, just before my Pacifica sunscreen. I started using it as soon as I heard about it!
Truly leaves my skin glowing from within, definitely keeping it as a part of my daily routine

I get a lot of dark marks on my face from acne scarring and this definitely has boosted the fading time of them. It doesn't work overnight and you do NEED to wear sunscreen for this to work (I think the vitamin C concentration is at the higher end of the average range), but with daily application, I generally see fading within a few weeks. I'm currently on my 3rd or 4th bottle of this and no longer fear acne scarring when a I get a new pimple! Just don't try to apply it directly to your face (which you shouldn't do with any dropper bottle anyways), because it does stain clothing.

avis.titre: Worst product I've ever put on my face
avis.texte: This made me break out. I'm talking DEEP pimples that took weeks to heal. I threw it in the trash.

Does this serum work well? yes. It leaves my skin brighter and dewy looking. Is it slightly sticky? yes. Not a big deal if you are using moisturizer and/or primer on top. It doesn't seem to cause a problem for make up. Does it smell like plasticky orange creamsicle? yes. WHY, Pacifica? Skincare does not need fragrance.

I love love LOVE this product. I love that it is affordable and most importantly cruelty free and vegan. Ive been using this for weeks…. And let me tell you I see the difference. My skin is glowing and radiant. It has helped even my skin tone and with blemishes. I feel comfortable using no makeup. Please never discontinue. A holy grail

I bought this for the impressive ingredient list (Vitamin C, Niacinamide, Hyaluronic Acid). It has delivered on its promises. My skin is brighter, my pores appear smaller, and it feels so hydrated. A well-formulated product.

As someone with more mature skin, I'm always looking for products that add radiance without settling into fine lines. This serum is a winner. It plumps up my skin and gives it a youthful glow. I feel so much more confident in my skin since I started using this.

avis.titre: A Game Changer for My Dull Skin
avis.texte: This serum has been a total game-changer. My skin used to look so dull and lifeless, but now it has a healthy, natural-looking glow. I feel like my skin is finally at its best. I will be repurchasing it over and over again.

avis.titre: Finally, a Serum That Doesn't Feel Greasy
avis.texte: I have oily skin, and most "glowy" products make me look like a disco ball. This one is different. It sinks right in and gives a beautiful, lit-from-within look without any greasiness. It has also helped to even out my skin tone. Highly recommend for fellow oily-skinned folks.

I have rosacea and have to be very careful with new products. This serum has been wonderfully gentle on my skin. It provides a subtle, healthy glow without any irritation. I'm so pleased to have found it.

I am obsessed! This serum has completely transformed my dull, tired-looking skin. I look like I've just had a facial every single day. The texture is lightweight and has a pleasant, subtle scent. A little goes a long way. I'm on my second bottle and don't plan on stopping!
I love using this before a special event or a night out. It gives my skin an instant boost of radiance that makes my makeup look flawless. It's like a secret weapon for glowing skin.

avis.titre: A Staple in My Morning Routine
avis.texte: I can't start my day without this serum. It wakes up my skin and gives it a healthy sheen that lasts. I mix a drop with my foundation for an extra dewy finish. It's a versatile and effective product.
Believe the hype! This serum is fantastic. I noticed a difference in my skin's luminosity within the first week. It's gentle, effective, and feels luxurious to apply. I'm a fan for life.

avis.titre: My Holy Grail for a Reason!
avis.texte: I've been using this Glow Booster Serum for a month now, and I am absolutely blown away. My skin has never looked so radiant and felt so smooth. It absorbs quickly, isn't sticky, and sits perfectly under my makeup. I've gotten so many compliments on my "natural glow." Worth every penny!

I love this serum for days when I don't want to wear a lot of makeup. It gives my skin such a beautiful, healthy look that I feel confident going bare-faced. It's my go-to for a natural, "I woke up like this" glow.

This serum is really hydrating. I use it every morning, and it gives my skin a nice, dewy look throughout the day. I haven't noticed a massive "glowing" effect, but it definitely helps my dry skin feel more comfortable and look healthier. It's a solid product.
This is a solid, reliable serum. It does what it claims: boosts glow and hydrates. No miracles, but a consistently good product that I enjoy using. It's become a trusted part of my routine.

avis.titre: It's Okay, But Not for Me
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this, but it just didn't work for my sensitive skin. I experienced some mild redness and irritation after a few days of use. The glow was there, but the side effects weren't worth it. I'd recommend a patch test for sure.

avis.titre: Nice, but the Scent is a Bit Strong
avis.texte: The serum itself works quite well and does give a nice glow. However, the fragrance is a little overwhelming for me. It's a pleasant scent, but I prefer my skincare to be fragrance-free. If you're sensitive to smells, this might not be for you.

avis.titre: A Bit Sticky for My Liking
avis.texte: The glow is definitely there, but I found the texture to be a bit sticky. It takes a while to fully absorb into my skin, and I don't love the tacky feeling it leaves behind. It's a decent product, but the texture is a deal-breaker for me.

The serum works well. It gives a noticeable glow and makes my skin feel soft. However, for the price point, I was expecting a more dramatic result. It's a nice luxury item, but I'm not sure if I'll repurchase it regularly.

I've been using this for a few weeks, and I'm not seeing the "glow" everyone is talking about. My skin feels a bit more hydrated, but that's about it. It's not a bad product, but it didn't live up to the hype for me.
So I have acne scars and redness skin and this product helps me a lot! I just use it in the night before to sleep and the next day I have glowy skin 🥰

avis.titre: Didn't See Much of a Difference
avis.texte: I used the entire bottle as directed, and I can't say I noticed a significant change in my skin's glow. It's a decent hydrator, but for the price, I was expecting more visible results.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: I received this full size product as a sample. Skeptical because it smelled great. However, I used a q-tip to get every last drop out of the bottle when I finished it. It made a noticeable difference in the texture of my skin. Will stain clothing.

avis.titre: Took a While, But It Works
avis.texte: I almost gave up on this serum after two weeks, but I'm glad I stuck with it. The results are not instant, but after about 3-4 weeks, I really started to see a noticeable improvement in my skin's overall radiance and texture. Patience is key!
I love this Serum!! It's light, but i feel like my skin is really soft. I use Pacifica face lotion on top when it drys. At 62 I feel like I have less laugh lines and wrinkles.

avis.titre: I would buy this product and other products from this line!!
avis.texte: This product not only smells good but feels good and gives a glow to your face. I use in the morning and at night!
its a cute item I didn't notice a major difference and it does smell nice but nothing I would repurchase or recommend
Use a drop every morning with Pacifica serum and its brightens my complexion
I use this over my moisturizer and I do love the fresh feel of my face . I recommend I use the glow face wash too. I will definitely buying this collection

Glow Baby brightening serum with vitamin C is one of my favorite Pacifica products. It goes on smoothly and my skin feels hydrated. I mix it into my daily moisturizer, Future Youth Super Cream. I'm ready for the day!

For me it didn't work I don't know if it was the bottle that is expired, but after i finish applying my skincare/make up products it tuns white so i have to wash my face anda start all over again. So I Just stopped using it. it didn't cause any problems on my skin, its just that it ruins my make up or if not using any makeup looks like I have a skin problem
This serum makes my face glow, not oily or breakout. It also smells really good!
This serum makes my face glow, not oily or breakout. It also smells really good!
I really love this serum. It brightens my skin, makes it soft and makes me look more awake. It smells amazing too, its not overpowering and i'm usually sensitive to smells.

This is my go-to vitamin c serum. I mix it with my moisturizer and spread it over my face. It's dry by the time I put on my makeup. I just absolutely love the way this stuff smells. It's a great product.
Personally all this has done is exaggerate my pores. It does smell good though and you get a lot of product for the price.
I used this every day. I add a large drop to my morning serum. It brightens my skin. GOOD PRICE
One of the worst products I've ever used. Eventually dried my skin out like a lizard. No glow involved. Won't let me return!
This is one of my favorite serums. It brightens and evens my skin tone and smells nice. Make sure to wear your sunscreen with it!!
I love this serum! It's not heavy and is easy to smooth on as part of a morning routine. It has a light scent and can be combined with other lotions

avis.titre: Smells amazing and noticeably brightens skin
avis.texte: This is my 2nd time purchasing this product. Overall I really love the brand and their other serums and products and have used quite a few of them. This is probably my favorite out of all of them and is the most effective. Plus I love the smell.
absolute need!! add to cart right now, change my skin in just a couple of weeks, my skin feels smooth and is so bright and glowy. especially helped to reduce dark spots!🤍
I love the smell and how it feels on my face along with the glow!

avis.titre: NEVER discontinue the glow baby collection!!!!!
avis.texte: After Pacifica discontinued the tuscan blood orange lotion, perfume and rose micellar water, it was absolutely devastating. Both rose and orange vegan products help my dry, sensitive pale skin not feel or be so dry and give me somewhat of a glow/color. I wish the size of this magnificent serum was either increased or the price was decreased to a third or half since it's not easy to keep borrowing money to buy it being unemployed. Don't ever discontinue this glow baby collection Pacifica because it's not always easy finding similar vegan products to replace them with.
This is a wonderful product! It's very light, easy to use and can be blended with other moisturizers. It has a light and not overwhelming scent. Great to daytime or anytime use

I'm 56 years old and have been using this product for 3 years. I also use Glow Baby Enzyme face scrub. My skin is firm, minimizes the look of my line lines. Absolutely recommend for mature skin. Oh, and my face is very sensitive, this doesn't bother my skin at all, makes it look healthy.
Absolutely love this. Feels nice and juicy, amazing scent and instant glowy skin.

I've tried many Vitamin C serums over the years but the Pacifica Glow Baby serum stands out from the crowd! I love the smell and texure of this product. It absorbs well and leaves my skin glowing. I have been using it for over a year in the mornings under a mositurizer.
This is the BEST serum I've ever used! It made my skin so smooth and shiny. I RECOMMEND! go buy it!💗💗

I've tried several Vitamin C serums, including Klairs and Paula's Choice, but none of them gave me the same results as Pacifica. This serum has truly been a game-changer for my skincare routine. I've noticed brighter, more even-toned skin with consistent use, something I didn't experience with other brands. I've been so impressed that I just ordered my 4th bottle!

I bought this serum because I love what Pacifica Beauty stands for and the clean ingredients and had never tried it before. This serum is so light and silky going on my skin and has a light fresh fragrance! It seems to brighten my skin and hydrate it without being oily or heavy. Will definitely buy again!
My skin's texture has so much improved. I totally recommend this product.
I have tried several Vitamin C serums and none have worked as good as this. It smells wonderful and you can't beat the price. My skin is glowing. This will always be my go to serum!

avis.titre: Great for Dull Skin, Does What It Says
avis.texte: I have been using this for about a year. 58 years old. Love the clean ingredients and that the packaging is recyclable. It really does make my skin glow.

i love this serum so much it feels so nice on my skin and it smells so good. it really does make a difference after a few days of using it my face looked just really healthy and glowy. highly recommend

I liked this serum. Didnt cause any breakouts. I have started many new skincare items so unsure if this has specifically made my skin better, but I do see a difference in my skin with the regimen I do.

I have used almost the entire bottle but do not notice any benefit from using this product. I also don't like how it smells like glazed donuts. The serum is lighter in color and runnier then other vitamin c serums I have used in the past.
This is literally one of my favorite serums from Pacifica. I'm on my mid thirties and the results are just.. wow! Less visible wrinkles, smooth, glowing skin.
I don't have sensitive skin and this stuff made me breakout with pimples and blackheads like CRAZY.. and its sticky. Smells good though
I absolutely love this product. A little bit goes a long way and it is a refreshing treatment first thing in the morning. The smell is lovely and the results are even better.

There is no glycolic acid percenatage in thsi profuct . Thats very dangerous to people with sensitive autoimmune skin like people with rosacea eczema skin . It made my skin sting burn and i had to stop . Maybe its fine to use once a week thing but dedintiely mot eervy day

Hi 👋 I was skeptical at first only because other products have broke my face out with boils and pimples! So, my friends who use this product haven't had any problems with that. I tried it on my face, and I love not only the best change in my complexion but the feel of my skin. It's awesome 👍. Highly recommend these products.
This is the only product that has helped me prevent acne. Even if I skip it for two days, I can see a difference. It's amazing and I hope it never ever gets discontinued.

This product smells amazing. Honestly, I want to rebuy it for that reason alone! But alas, I'm not sure it really did anything at all for my skin. It does feel goodand my skin looks good immediately after using. But after going through an entire bottle, I'm just not sure I really see any improvement. I may or may not buy again. May be worth another try for the smell alone!
I love the way this serum brighten my face!! Well continue using it..
Holy skin. I am 46. And use the glow baby. Omg why a huge difference in my skin it is bright and plump and heathy. Love all the glow baby products
I put this on every morning and combine it with my NO7 vitamin C moisturizer and it smells INCREDIBLE together!
I love this serum, it does wonders for my dry skin and really brightens my complexion!

My skin loves vitamin c so i got this in a package deal. I am now done with it and I don't think it did much for my skin? Around my mouth and under my eyes are still darker than the rest of my face—with the right products (like the flor & nora toner) my skin has evened out. It does do nicely to hydrate my normal/combo skin overnight if i forget to put on moisturizer after. I would be OK in the morning, but would still in mosturizer for the day. I used this consistently and I don't see any improvements in my skin. I don't have sensitive skin, but I do have stubborn skin. It needs something strong to whip it into shape. If you have sensitive skin, this might be for you.

I wanted to like this product because it does make my skin look great, but i can not get over how sticky it is. Even after drying and putting moisturizer on after it's still sticky. Ill be taking this out of my skin care routine.

I am not a fan of heavily fragrant products on my face. Ended up being very sticky on my face and kinda burns . Saw no change besides it making my skin more sensitive. I read great reviews and decided to try. But its a no for me.

I've been using this for a couple of years now. Every once and awhile I will stop for a while, or try another vitamin c serum, but I end up coming back to this one and I really need to stop trying others! This serum brightens and evens my complexion to the point I don't use makeup. I get so many compliments on my skin. I only use this at night since I have oily skin during the day, especially in warmer weather. But it also provides moisture when I use at night. Please don't ever stop making this product!!!

I love this product! I have mature skin (40's), combo/hyper-pigmented skin and was a former smoker and it was looking dry, dull and overall awful. I use to wear a full face of makeup daily now I mix this with my sunscreen (Neutrogena, Ultra Sheer® Oil-Free Face Serum With Vitamin E SPF 60+) & that's it! I'm outdoors about 70% of the time for work and it holds up all day for me. I love that it's affordable, as I've spent lots on more expensive brands, and this holds up just as well if not better. My skin has never looked better!!

This product goes on well and isn't sticky, however smell reminds me of candy or an Orange Julius, and I can't stand it on my face. It's not a terrible smell, it's just not something I want to put on my face.

avis.titre: An affordable serum that actually works!
avis.texte: I've been using this for a couple of years now and it is amazing! My skin instantly brightens, looks tighter and glows. Plus it's affordable and works better than expensive serums I've tried! Love this product!

OMG!!! This serum is the absolute best I've ever tried! The formula is super lightweight and goes on effortlessly. It smells like heaven, almost like an orange smoothie! The best, I recommend to everyone!

My morning ritual besides good coffee, is putting Glow Baby on my face & neck. It smells + feels delicious. It's the right way to kick off my day; glowing inside and out. My skin feels dehydrated after god-willing, 7 hours of sleep in a dry climate. Skin is thirsty in the a.m. + a little dull so this kiss of C makes me feel great + my skin looks so pretty.

This Vitamin C serum exceeded my expectations. I have sensitive, mature skin and this did not irritate my skin at all. It absorbs quickly and wears well under makeup. Additionally, I saw a brightening glow to my complexion almost immediately. This is a keeper! I plan to try other skin care from this brand.
Love this Vit-c and glycolic acid serum. I use it every morning. Its gentle on my skin but keeps it bright and smells great. Its the perfect start of the day.
I love this booster serum it's been helping my skin out so much, and i'm so thankful to find one i love using it's my 3rd bottle of this and ill keep using it till its not sold anymore

The item had a medication-like smell to me and I couldnt stand the smell being on my face, unfortunately. Tried it out due to the nice price compared to most vitamin C products but its worth it to me to spend more on something else.
The mornign after i used this i could see a difference in my skin and day after dsy im seeing more improvement. I love it! Im keeping it as part of my skin care routine.
Lightweight and not sticky. I definetely feel like my skin looks brighter after use.
This is absolutely the best product i own! It smells amazing, goes on well. I will definitely be repurchasing this!

I got this as a gift in a set and I love it so much! Use it daily as a makeup primer and it makes my skin so soft. It really helps with acne and it makes my skin feel like butter. Would totally recommend!
LOVE LOVE LOVE!! This serum is a part of my daily morning routine, I love how quickly it absorbs into the skin and the smell is delightful.
